description: Godot 4+ 2D/3D development: GDScript 2.0 static typing, C# integration, decoupled node composition, signal-driven communication, physics tick optimization, and GLSL shaders.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Godot 4+ Systems Architecture & GDScript

Build modular, high-performance 2D and 3D games using Godot 4 and strictly-typed GDScript.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Enforce static type annotations (`var speed: float = 10.0`) on all GDScript variables and functions.
- Decouple node hierarchies: call down using method calls, signal up using typed custom `signal`s.
- Isolate physics calculations inside `_physics_process(delta)` and rendering updates inside `_process(delta)`.
- Reuse shared `Resource` objects across scene instances to minimize RAM footprint.
